headline: Anupam Rasayan submits AGM scrutinizer report and e-voting results
hook: Procedural compliance filing from Anupam Rasayan
summary: Anupam Rasayan India Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and e-voting results for its 23rd Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing required by stock exchanges. Retail shareholders can review the passed resolutions through the company's regulatory disclosures. The filing has no direct material impact on the company's financial performance or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact on investments.
